sentenceUpgrade.techniques: We are thrilled to announce 通告套语 + 时间状语(starting next month) + 生动动词(roll into) + so that 目的状语体现关怀

original_sentence: Users who access the Internet using mobile devices.
readingExamples: Users who access the Internet using mobile devices.
definitionEn:
(1) n. an object or piece of equipment that has been made for a particular purpose
(2) n. a plan, method or trick used to achieve a particular aim or effect
(3) n. a bomb or other piece of equipment made to explode
(4) n. a technique used in writing, art or speech to create a particular effect

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 手段，策略，花招（为达到目的而使用的方法）
uncommonMeanings.example: Feigning a sudden headache was merely a device to escape the crowded hall, for what she truly longed for was a quiet corner where she could be alone with her thoughts. （读后续写·内心逃避·借口花招）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （文学、修辞中的）技巧，手法
uncommonMeanings.example: The writer's clever use of foreshadowing as a narrative device left readers gasping when the twist was finally revealed. （议论文·文学赏析·叙事手法）

posExamples.sentence: Trapped beneath the rubble, the old miner fashioned a crude signalling device from a torch and a shard of mirror, flashing desperate beams towards the searchlights above. （读后续写·绝境自救）
I am writing to recommend a small energy-saving device that automatically switches off idle appliances, which could greatly reduce our school's electricity bill. （应用文·建议信）
However dazzling our devices become, they remain mere tools; whether they enrich or enslave us depends entirely on the hand that holds them. （议论文·科技与人）
The data reveals that a growing number of users now access the Internet using mobile devices, from smartphones to tablets. （应用文·图表描述）

idioms.idiom: leave sb. to their own devices
idioms.translation: 任由某人自行其是；不加干涉
idioms.example: Left to their own devices for the whole afternoon, the two brothers built a fort out of cardboard boxes that would have made any architect proud. （读后续写·童年自由）

collocations.example: Please switch off all electronic devices before the performance begins. （应用文·剧场须知）
With a single handheld device, a modern student can carry an entire library in a pocket. （议论文·科技便利）
The tiny medical device implanted in his chest quietly monitored every beat of his fragile heart. （读后续写·病患）
Children should be taught to use such devices responsibly rather than losing themselves in endless scrolling. （议论文·教育）
Smart devices now regulate the temperature, lighting and security of an entire home from a single screen. （应用文·产品介绍）
The washing machine, that humble labour-saving device, freed generations of women from hours of daily drudgery. （议论文·科技解放）
Detectives discovered a tiny tracking device hidden beneath the fugitive's stolen car. （读后续写·悬疑）
The engineer invented a simple device for filtering rainwater, a blessing for the drought-stricken village. （读后续写·发明）

synonyms.example: His pockets were always full of curious little gadgets that he had taken apart and cleverly rebuilt. （读后续写·发明少年）
synonyms.usage: 口语化，指新奇小巧、常带趣味的小设备；device 更正式、中性，可大可小，适用范围更广

synonyms.example: The surgeon reached for a delicate instrument, her hand as steady as a rock. （读后续写·手术）
synonyms.usage: 多指用于精密测量、科学或医疗的专业器械；device 泛指为特定用途制造的任何器具，也可指抽象的'手段'

synonyms.example: Every appliance in the kitchen, from the kettle to the oven, hummed to life at the touch of an app. （应用文·智能家居）
synonyms.usage: 特指家用电器等大型器具；device 更广，涵盖从大型机器到手持小工具乃至抽象策略

advancedExpressions.expression: with nothing but a makeshift device, sb. ...
advancedExpressions.example: With nothing but a makeshift device cobbled together from wire and a broken radio, they managed to send out a faint call for help. （with nothing but 突出条件之窘迫 + 分词修饰，续写彰显机智）

advancedExpressions.expression: this ingenious device enables us to ...
advancedExpressions.example: This ingenious little device enables us to monitor our daily water usage at a glance, encouraging everyone to save every precious drop. （ingenious 褒扬 + enable sb. to do 强调功能，推荐信句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: the device we invent to serve us may end up mastering us
advancedExpressions.example: The very device we invent to serve us may end up mastering us, unless we remember that the true intelligence must lie in the user, not the machine. （主谓宾结构 + unless 条件 + 对比(user / machine)，警示论证）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He used a small device to call for help.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Fumbling in the darkness, he rigged up a crude signalling device from the wreckage, and with the last flicker of hope pulsing in his chest, he began flashing three short beams into the endless night. （读后续写·绝境求救）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 分词状语(Fumbling in the darkness) + 生动动词(rigged up, flashing) + 心理描写(flicker of hope pulsing) + 数字细节(three short beams)

sentenceUpgrade.original: This device can help us save energy.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: I sincerely believe that installing this simple yet ingenious device throughout the school would not only cut our energy bills but also nurture in every student a lasting sense of environmental responsibility. （应用文·建议信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: I sincerely believe that 正式主句 + simple yet ingenious 对比修饰 + not only...but also 递进 + nurture a sense of 抽象升华

original_sentence: I was a smartphone addict.
readingExamples: I was a smartphone addict.
definitionEn:
(1) n. someone who is unable to stop taking harmful drugs, or unable to stop doing an activity that they enjoy in an unhealthy way
(2) n. (informal) someone who is extremely interested in a particular activity and spends as much time as possible on it
(3) vt. (usu. passive: be addicted to) to make someone unable to stop taking a drug or doing an activity

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (常用被动 addict oneself to) 使沉溺、使入迷
uncommonMeanings.example: For three whole years he had addicted himself to the roar of the crowd, and now, standing in the empty stadium, he wondered who he was without it. （读后续写·退役运动员·身份迷失）

posExamples.sentence: Once a hopeless game addict who greeted every dawn with bloodshot eyes, Tom now closed his laptop at nine sharp, laced up his running shoes, and let the cool morning air wash the screen-glow out of his mind. （读后续写·自律蜕变）
I am writing to warn my fellow students that many of us are becoming unwitting addicts of short videos, scrolling for hours while our textbooks gather dust on the desk. （应用文·倡议书）
It would be unfair to dismiss every heavy gamer as a hopeless addict, for the real problem lies not in the game itself but in our inability to set reasonable limits. （议论文·网络成瘾）
As a self-confessed book addict, Grandma could lose herself in a novel for an entire afternoon, deaf to the whistling kettle and the ringing phone. （读后续写·人物刻画）

collocations.example: The documentary followed a former drug addict who, after years in the shadows, now devoted his life to steering teenagers away from the same abyss. （读后续写·救赎）
Refusing to be a smartphone addict any longer, she deleted every game and taped a note to her mirror: 'Look up and live.' （读后续写·自我救赎）
His parents feared he had become a gaming addict, for the boy who once loved football now spoke only to a glowing screen. （读后续写·家庭）
A self-proclaimed coffee addict, our teacher joked that his morning class simply would not happen without a steaming mug at his side. （应用文·人物介绍）
Everyone had written him off as a hopeless addict, yet within him still flickered a stubborn spark of the will to change. （读后续写·转折）
As a recovering addict, he measured his progress not in grand victories but in the small triumph of each phone-free evening. （读后续写·励志）

collocations.translation: 肾上腺素成瘾者（极限运动迷）
collocations.example: An adrenaline addict at heart, she chased one steep cliff after another, convinced that she felt most alive at the very edge of danger. （读后续写·探险）
Clever game designers know exactly which rewards can turn a curious child into an addict before he even realizes it. （议论文·科技伦理）

synonyms.example: A lifelong film enthusiast, Mr. Lee could recite entire scenes from memory, his eyes lighting up at the mere mention of a classic. （应用文·人物介绍）
synonyms.usage: 褒义、中性，指对某事物有健康而热烈的兴趣；不含'上瘾、失控'的贬义，可安全用于夸奖某人的爱好。

synonyms.example: 'You're such a news junkie,' his sister teased, watching him refresh the headlines for the tenth time before breakfast. （读后续写·对话）
synonyms.usage: 口语、俚语色彩极强，比 addict 更随意、略带调侃或贬损；正式作文中慎用，读后续写口语对话里可增添生活气息。

synonyms.example: As a fitness fanatic, she never let a rainy morning become an excuse to skip her five-kilometre run. （读后续写·自律）
synonyms.usage: 强调痴迷到近乎极端的程度，情感比 addict 更强烈；可褒可贬，视语境而定，常用于形容对运动、宗教、某项爱好的狂热。

advancedExpressions.expression: no longer a slave / addict to ..., sb. finally ...
advancedExpressions.example: No longer a slave to that little glowing screen, she finally lifted her eyes to the world and saw the sky she had ignored for years. （对比+隐喻，续写升华段展现觉醒）

advancedExpressions.expression: before we become addicts of ..., let us ...
advancedExpressions.example: Before we all become addicts of endless scrolling, let us reclaim our time and rediscover the quiet joys of reading, sport and real conversation. （倡议书结尾号召，before引导警示）

advancedExpressions.expression: the line between an enthusiast and an addict lies in ...
advancedExpressions.example: The line between a healthy enthusiast and a helpless addict lies not in how much we love something, but in whether we can still walk away from it. （对比句式，界定核心论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He was addicted to his phone and could not stop.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The phone had become a second heartbeat he could not silence; like a true addict, he reached for it the instant a conversation paused, a queue formed, or a moment of stillness threatened to let his own thoughts catch up with him. （读后续写·心理描写+比喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 隐喻(a second heartbeat) + like a true addict 明喻 + 三项排比(a conversation paused / a queue formed / a moment of stillness threatened) 铺陈成瘾细节

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should not let students become phone addicts.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is therefore incumbent upon both schools and families to act before more of our young people slide from casual users into helpless addicts, robbed of their focus, their sleep and, ultimately, their curiosity about the wider world. （应用文·建议信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is incumbent upon sb. to do 正式责任句式 + slide from ... into ... 渐变动词 + 三名词排比(focus, sleep, curiosity)递进强调后果

translation: 全神贯注看着某物，离某物很近
original_sentence: My eyes were glued to the little screen whenever I walked down the street, had dinner with friends or lay in bed at night.
readingExamples: My eyes were glued to the little screen whenever I walked down the street, had dinner with friends or lay in bed at night.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. to keep looking at something with all your attention, especially a screen, so that you notice nothing else
(2) phr. to stay very close to something or someone and be unwilling to move away
(3) phr. (of the eyes/gaze) to be fixed firmly on something as if unable to look away

posExamples.sentence: For the whole flight the little boy sat glued to the window, his nose pressed against the cold glass, watching the clouds unfold beneath him like a vast field of snow. （读后续写·童真视角）
I have noticed that during meals many students remain glued to their phones, letting the food go cold and the family conversation die away. （应用文·倡议书）

When millions of citizens stay glued to their screens for hours a day, we must ask ourselves what precious things — time, health, real connection — are quietly slipping through our fingers. （议论文·数字生活）
As the final whistle approached, the entire class was glued to the live broadcast, hardly daring to breathe until the winning goal sent the room into a roar. （读后续写·集体场面）

idioms.idiom: be glued to the television / TV
idioms.example: Every Spring Festival Eve, the whole family would be glued to the television, laughing at the gala long past midnight. （读后续写·节日温情）

idioms.idiom: keep one's eyes glued to sth
idioms.example: She kept her eyes glued to the door, her heart leaping at every footstep, praying that the next one would be his. （读后续写·期盼）

collocations.phrase: be glued to the screen / phone
collocations.translation: 目不转睛地盯着屏幕／手机
collocations.example: Hour after hour he was glued to the screen, unaware that outside his window the sun had risen, blazed and finally sunk behind the hills. （读后续写·虚度光阴）
Eyes glued to the exam board, she scanned the endless list of names, her breath caught somewhere between hope and dread. （读后续写·放榜心理）
The children sat glued to the storyteller, their eyes wide, their half-eaten snacks forgotten in their hands. （读后续写·出神）

collocations.translation: 站在原地一动不动（惊呆／害怕）
collocations.example: At the sudden crash, she stood glued to the spot, unable to move a single muscle as her heart hammered against her ribs. （读后续写·惊恐）
The frightened puppy remained glued to the boy's side, trembling at every stranger who passed. （读后续写·陪伴）

collocations.phrase: have one's face glued to the window
collocations.example: With his face glued to the window, the child counted the raindrops racing down the glass, willing the storm to pass. （读后续写·等待）

synonyms.example: So absorbed was she in the novel that she never heard the bell ring or the classroom empty around her. （读后续写·倒装+专注）
synonyms.usage: 强调'沉浸投入'的积极专注，多用于阅读、工作、思考；比 be glued to 更书面、更褒义，可安全用于议论文正面论述。

synonyms.example: For weeks he was fixated on that one mistake, replaying it endlessly until it swallowed every other thought. （读后续写·心理执念）
synonyms.usage: 带有'过度、不健康地聚焦'的贬义，侧重心理上的执迷；be glued to 更侧重视线／身体的固定，fixated 更侧重内心的执着。

synonyms.example: Within a single evening she was hooked on the mystery series, promising herself 'just one more episode' until the sky turned grey. （读后续写·上瘾）
synonyms.usage: 口语化，强调'着迷上瘾、欲罢不能'，偏重持续性的兴趣或习惯；be glued to 侧重此刻的目不转睛，二者可搭配使用增强层次。

advancedExpressions.expression: eyes glued to ..., sb. failed to notice ...
advancedExpressions.example: Eyes glued to the tiny screen, he failed to notice the old man beside him struggling with his heavy bags, nor the disappointed look that crossed the stranger's face. （视线固定+错过现实的反差，续写伏笔）

advancedExpressions.expression: it has become a common sight to see sb. glued to ...
advancedExpressions.example: It has become an all-too-common sight to see families sitting together yet glued to separate screens, present in body but absent in heart. （倡议书点明现象，present in body but absent in heart 对仗）

advancedExpressions.expression: when sb. is forever glued to ..., sb. risks losing ...
advancedExpressions.example: When a generation is forever glued to its devices, it risks losing the rare and precious skill of simply being still — of noticing, reflecting and truly seeing the world. （破折号补充+三动词递进论证）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He looked at his phone all the time and did not notice anything.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Head bowed and eyes glued to the little glowing screen, he drifted through the crowded street like a sleepwalker — deaf to the laughter, blind to the blossoms, oblivious to the very world that streamed unnoticed past his feet. （读后续写·环境+心理描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 过去分词短语作状语(Head bowed and eyes glued) + like a sleepwalker 明喻 + deaf...blind...oblivious 三形容词排比强化脱离现实

sentenceUpgrade.original: Many people watch their phones too much these days.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In an age when countless people remain glued to their phones from the moment they wake to the moment they sleep, we would do well to ask whether we still own our attention, or whether it has quietly been sold to the highest bidder. （议论文·反思科技）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: In an age when... 时代背景状语从句 + from the moment...to the moment 时间对仗 + whether...or whether 二选一设问引发思考

original_sentence: I always asked for Wi-Fi connections when I went to a new restaurant or coffee shop.
readingExamples: I always asked for Wi-Fi connections when I went to a new restaurant or coffee shop.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a system that uses radio waves to connect computers, phones and other devices to the internet without wires
(2) n. a wireless network connection available in a particular place, such as a home, café or airport

posExamples.sentence: The moment the storm knocked out the Wi-Fi, the whole family looked up from their screens, blinked at one another, and — for the first time in months — began to actually talk. （读后续写·断网重聚）
To help students focus during study hours, I would like to suggest that the school switch off the dormitory Wi-Fi from ten o'clock each night. （应用文·建议信）
Free public Wi-Fi has undeniably made our lives more convenient, yet it also tempts us to stay online every waking minute, at the quiet cost of our concentration and peace of mind. （议论文·科技双刃剑）

collocations.example: As soon as the plane landed, dozens of hands reached for phones, everyone racing to connect to the airport Wi-Fi. （读后续写·现代群像）
The little café drew a steady crowd of students, less for its coffee than for its free Wi-Fi and quiet corners. （应用文·场所介绍）

collocations.phrase: the Wi-Fi is down / not working
collocations.example: When the Wi-Fi was down for a whole afternoon, she rediscovered an old paperback and, to her surprise, could not put it down. （读后续写·意外收获）
Deep in the mountains the Wi-Fi signal vanished completely, and only then did the hikers hear the true silence of the forest. （读后续写·自然）
With only a weak Wi-Fi signal in the old classroom, the online lesson kept freezing, testing everyone's patience. （应用文·情况反映）
'The Wi-Fi password?' the waiter smiled. 'It's on the wall — but honestly, the view outside is worth logging off for.' （读后续写·对话）

synonyms.example: The library installed a fast wireless network so that students could look up references from any seat in the hall. （应用文·设施介绍）
synonyms.usage: 较正式、书面的说法，Wi-Fi 是其常见口语和日常称呼；正式通知、报告中可用 wireless network，日常表达用 Wi-Fi 更自然。

synonyms.example: A stable internet connection turned out to be the one thing the remote village school needed most. （议论文·教育公平）
synonyms.usage: 范围更广，泛指一切上网连接（含有线、移动数据），不特指无线；Wi-Fi 特指近距离无线接入。

advancedExpressions.expression: the moment the Wi-Fi died, ...
advancedExpressions.example: The moment the Wi-Fi died, a strange thing happened: the silence that everyone had dreaded slowly turned into the warmest evening the family had shared in years. （断网转折，续写以'失去'引出'获得'）

advancedExpressions.expression: I would suggest limiting Wi-Fi access to ... so that ...
advancedExpressions.example: I would suggest limiting dormitory Wi-Fi access to certain hours so that students may enjoy uninterrupted sleep and undivided focus. （建议信句式，so that 引出目的）

advancedExpressions.expression: Wi-Fi has liberated us and imprisoned us in equal measure
advancedExpressions.example: In truth, Wi-Fi has liberated us and imprisoned us in equal measure — granting the whole world at our fingertips while quietly stealing the world right in front of us. （对偶+对比，辩证论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: There was no Wi-Fi, so we talked to each other.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Stripped of Wi-Fi by the sudden blackout, we had nothing left to hide behind — and so, awkwardly at first and then with growing warmth, we began to talk, really talk, in a way we had somehow forgotten how to do. （读后续写·情感转变）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 过去分词状语(Stripped of Wi-Fi) + 破折号补充 + awkwardly...then with warmth 副词递进 + really talk 重复强调

sentenceUpgrade.original: Free Wi-Fi is convenient but makes people always online.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: While free Wi-Fi has woven convenience into the very fabric of daily life, it has also chained countless people to a screen from dawn to dusk, so that they are always connected to the network yet increasingly disconnected from one another. （议论文·双刃剑）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: While 让步状语从句 + woven...into the fabric 隐喻 + connected...yet disconnected 词根对比制造反讽

original_sentence: A dead battery in my smartphone would make me feel stressed.
readingExamples: A dead battery in my smartphone would make me feel stressed.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a device that produces electricity to provide power for radios, cars, phones and other equipment
(2) n. a group of similar things, especially a large number of them arranged or used together
(3) n. (law) the crime of attacking someone physically

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 一系列，一大批（同类事物）
uncommonMeanings.example: Before he could join the expedition, the young climber had to pass a battery of medical tests, each one stricter than the last. （读后续写·选拔考验）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （法律）殴打罪，人身侵犯
uncommonMeanings.example: The old records revealed that the seemingly gentle landlord had once been charged with assault and battery — a secret the whole village had chosen to forget. （读后续写·悬疑伏笔）

posExamples.sentence: As the last bar of the battery blinked red, panic tightened its grip on her chest — the map, the address, her only lifeline in this unfamiliar city, was about to go dark. （读后续写·困境）
To reduce electronic waste, I would like to propose that our school set up special bins where students can safely dispose of used batteries. （应用文·倡议书）

The rapid development of battery technology lies at the very heart of the clean-energy revolution, for without cheaper and longer-lasting batteries, electric cars will never truly replace petrol ones. （议论文·科技与环保）
Halfway up the mountain his torch flickered and died; with a dead battery and the night closing in, he had no choice but to feel his way forward, one careful step at a time. （读后续写·历险）

idioms.example: After a gruelling term, she went home to the quiet countryside to recharge her batteries, letting the birdsong and fresh air slowly knit her back together. （读后续写·休整）

collocations.example: A dead battery in the middle of nowhere forced the two brothers to abandon the car and set off on foot, their adventure only just beginning. （读后续写·转折）
He plugged in his phone to charge the battery, watching the little icon climb as if it could speed up the passing hours. （读后续写·等待）
Just as she reached the thrilling final page of the e-book, the battery ran out, leaving the story — and her heart — hanging in mid-air. （读后续写·意外）
With a low battery and no charger in sight, he switched off every unnecessary app, hoarding each percent like a traveller rationing water in a desert. （读后续写·比喻）
Switching to rechargeable batteries is a small change, yet across a whole school it can spare the environment a mountain of toxic waste. （应用文·环保建议）
The new laptop boasted a battery life of fifteen hours, enough to carry her through an entire day of revision without once hunting for a socket. （应用文·产品介绍）
The little radio ran on batteries, and through the long power cut it became the family's only window to the outside world. （读后续写·困境中的温情）
The interview began gently enough, but soon the panel unleashed a battery of questions that left even the most confident candidate reaching for words. （读后续写·面试）

synonyms.example: The engineer explained that each solar cell converts sunlight directly into electricity, needing no fuel at all. （议论文·新能源）
synonyms.usage: 指单个电池单元或电芯，是构成 battery 的基本单位；battery 通常指成组的电池或整块电池，日常'电池'多用 battery。

synonyms.example: A sudden failure of the power supply plunged the whole laboratory into darkness moments before the crucial experiment. （读后续写·突发）
synonyms.usage: 泛指供电系统或电源装置，范围比 battery 广，可指电网、发电机等；battery 特指便携式储电装置。

synonyms.translation: 一大批，一系列（=battery 的'一系列'义）
synonyms.example: The museum displayed a dazzling array of ancient artefacts, each telling its own silent story of the past. （应用文·参观介绍）
synonyms.usage: 作'一大批、一系列'讲时与 battery of 近义，但 array 更强调'排列陈列、种类丰富'，battery of 更强调'接连不断地施加'（如 a battery of tests）。

advancedExpressions.expression: with the battery down to its last ..., sb. ...

translation: (quit, quit; quitted, quitted) 停止，戒掉；离开

(2) vt. & vi. to leave a job, school or activity, especially permanently

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （计算机）退出、关闭（程序）

collocations.example: Quitting the habit of late-night scrolling proved far harder than she had imagined, yet each phone-free night felt like a small, hard-won victory. （读后续写·自律）

She quit her comfortable job in the city to teach in a remote mountain village, trading a fat salary for the light in her students' eyes. （读后续写·奉献）

No matter how the audience jeered, she would not quit playing, letting each trembling note answer their doubt with quiet defiance. （读后续写·坚持）
Champions are not those who never stumble, but those who refuse to quit halfway when the road grows steep. （议论文·成功论）
This time he was determined to quit for good, and he tore up the last packet so that no weak moment could ever tempt him again. （读后续写·决心）
After thirty glorious years, the veteran actor chose to quit the stage at his peak, bowing out to thunderous applause. （读后续写·谢幕）

synonyms.example: However dark the night grew, she refused to give up, clinging to the faint belief that dawn was hiding just beyond the ridge. （读后续写·励志）
synonyms.usage: 最常用、口语书面皆宜；'放弃努力'和'戒掉'两义都可，比 quit 略正式一点。表'戒掉习惯'时 give up 与 quit 通用，如 give up / quit smoking。

synonyms.translation: 抛弃，放弃（含'不负责任'意味）

synonyms.usage: 语气比 quit 重，强调'彻底舍弃、丢下不管'，常带贬义或情感色彩（抛弃人、职责、计划）；quit 更中性，多指停止习惯或离开岗位。

synonyms.example: Taking full responsibility for the failure, the manager chose to resign with dignity rather than shift the blame onto his team. （议论文／应用文·担当）
synonyms.usage: 特指'正式辞去职务'，书面、正式，常见于职场语境；quit one's job 更口语随意，resign 更庄重且强调'正式提出'。

advancedExpressions.expression: no matter how ..., sb. would not quit

advancedExpressions.expression: let us press on and never quit until ...

advancedExpressions.expression: the difference between success and failure often lies in whether one quits

sentenceUpgrade.original: It was hard for him to quit the habit.

sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 动名词作主语 + like tearing off a part of himself 明喻 + begged 拟人 + every ounce of will 夸张强调戒断之难

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It would be a grave mistake to quit the moment the going gets tough, for history has shown, time and again, that the sweetest fruits of perseverance ripen only for those who have the courage to endure just a little longer. （议论文·坚持）

original_sentence: Head down, eyes on my smartphone, I stepped into the road and a car shot past, nearly knocking me off my feet!
readingExamples: Head down, eyes on my smartphone, I stepped into the road and a car shot past, nearly knocking me off my feet!
definitionEn:
(1) phr. to move past someone or something very quickly, especially in a sudden rush
(2) phr. (of time) to seem to pass extremely fast
(3) phr. to travel or go past a point at high speed without stopping

posExamples.sentence: Head down and eyes on his phone, he stepped off the kerb just as a delivery van shot past, its horn blasting, missing him by no more than a breath. （读后续写·险情）
I still remember how the school years seemed to shoot past — one moment we were nervous newcomers, and the next we stood at the gate, holding our diplomas and fighting back tears. （应用文·毕业感言）
When we bury ourselves in our screens, the truly precious moments of life shoot past unnoticed, and by the time we look up, they are already beyond our reach. （议论文·珍惜时光）
A silver blur shot past the finish line half a second before the rest, and only when the crowd erupted did she realize the runner in front was her own little brother. （读后续写·比赛惊喜）

collocations.example: A car shot past so close that the rush of wind snatched the cap right off his head and sent it tumbling down the street. （读后续写·惊险）
A cyclist shot past her on the narrow path, and her heart lurched as she stumbled back against the railing. （读后续写·受惊）
With a final desperate burst, he shot past the finish line, collapsing onto the track as the roar of the crowd washed over him. （读后续写·冲刺）
The three years of high school shot past like a single vivid dream, leaving behind a scrapbook of friendships she would treasure for life. （读后续写／应用文·怀旧）
The express train shot past at full speed, its windows a golden ribbon of light streaking through the darkness. （读后续写·夜景）

collocations.translation: 径直从某人／某物旁飞驰而过
collocations.example: So lost in thought was she that her own bus shot right past the stop before she even raised her head. （读后续写·走神）

synonyms.example: Cars whizzed past the terrified child, who stood frozen on the island in the middle of the roaring road. （读后续写·惊恐）
synonyms.usage: 口语、生动，常带'呼呼声'的画面感，多形容车辆、子弹等疾速掠过；与 shoot past 近义，whizz past 更突出'声音+速度'的双重感官冲击。

synonyms.example: A boy dashed past, chasing his runaway kite, laughter trailing behind him like a bright ribbon. （读后续写·童趣）
synonyms.usage: 多指人快速跑过，强调'奔跑'的动作；shoot past 更强调'突然、迅猛如射出'，可用于车、人、时间，范围更广。

synonyms.example: The summer holiday flew by, and before she knew it, the first crisp morning of autumn was tapping at her window. （读后续写·时光）
synonyms.usage: '时间飞逝'义与 shoot past 相近，fly by 更柔和、常用；形容实物疾驰时，shoot past 的冲击力和突然感更强。

advancedExpressions.expression: just as sb. ..., sth. shot past, ...

advancedExpressions.expression: how quickly these years have shot past

advancedExpressions.expression: life shoots past those who refuse to look up

sentenceUpgrade.original: A car went by very fast and almost hit me.

sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Out of nowhere 突发状语 + in a deafening blur 感官描写 + grazing my sleeve 细节 + for one frozen heartbeat 时间凝滞 + the world narrowed to 心理聚焦

sentenceUpgrade.original: Time passes quickly when we waste it on our phones.

translation: 撞倒某人，使某人双脚离地

posExamples.sentence: Head down and lost in thought, I never saw the cyclist coming; in a blur of metal and shouting he swerved and clipped my shoulder, nearly knocking me off my feet on the crowded crossing. （读后续写·街头惊险瞬间）

collocations.phrase: knock sb off one's feet with joy / shock

collocations.phrase: a car / wave / crowd knocks sb off one's feet

collocations.phrase: knock sb flat off one's feet
collocations.example: The charging dog knocked the little boy flat off his feet, but instead of crying, he burst into delighted laughter. （读后续写·温馨童趣）

synonyms.example: The speeding scooter knocked an elderly man down at the zebra crossing, and a dozen passers-by rushed to help him up. （读后续写·街头事故）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:knock sb down 强调把人撞倒在地、常伴受伤，语气更直接、更常见；knock sb off one's feet 更强调'双脚离地、失去平衡'这一瞬间画面，也可作比喻'震撼'。

synonyms.translation: 撞翻某人；使某人大为震惊

sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 动词 loomed 营造压迫感 + 明喻 like hollow eyes + 通感 scary stillness pressed in + 现在分词 creaking 补声音细节

translation: 不知怎么地；以某种方式（或方法）
original_sentence: Then somehow I began to feel free.
readingExamples: Then somehow I began to feel free.
definitionEn:
(1) adv. in some way, or by some means, though you do not know how
(2) adv. for a reason that is not clear or that you cannot explain
(3) adv. used to say that you will do something even though it seems difficult

posExamples.sentence: The storm had knocked out the power and torn the tent to shreds, yet somehow we made it through the night, huddled together and laughing at our own misfortune. （读后续写·逆境求生）
I promise that, however tight the budget may be, we will somehow raise enough funds to send every child in the shelter a warm winter coat. （应用文·倡议/募捐信）
Somehow, the students who fail the most often turn out to be the ones who succeed the most spectacularly — a paradox that reveals the true value of perseverance. （议论文·失败与成功）
Then somehow, standing alone on that empty road with only birdsong for company, I began to feel a lightness I had not known in years. （读后续写·心境转变）

wordForms.other: someway (非标准/口语变体), somehow or other (强调)

idioms.translation: 不知怎么地；总之设法（强调）
idioms.example: Somehow or other, the little dog always found its way home, no matter how far it wandered. （读后续写·忠犬归途）
We had no map and no signal, but somehow or another we stumbled onto the right trail just as the sun dipped below the ridge. （读后续写·迷路脱险）

collocations.translation: 不知怎么地设法做成某事
collocations.example: Trembling with cold, she somehow managed to light the last match and coax a tiny flame from the damp firewood. （读后续写·绝境自救）
The old classroom somehow felt smaller than I remembered, though nothing about it had really changed. （读后续写·故地重游）
Somehow or other, he had memorised the entire poem overnight, astonishing even his strictest teacher. （读后续写·惊人毅力）
I told myself that I would somehow finish the marathon, even if I had to crawl across the finish line. （读后续写·坚持信念）
We set out to buy groceries and somehow ended up rescuing a stray kitten from a drainpipe. （读后续写·意外插曲）

collocations.translation: 莫名地知道 / 感觉到
collocations.example: Though no one had spoken, she somehow sensed that something was terribly wrong the instant she opened the door. （读后续写·不祥预感）
The small business somehow survived the harshest winter in a decade, thanks to the loyalty of its regular customers. （议论文/记叙·坚韧主题）

synonyms.example: In some way I could not quite name, that brief encounter changed the course of my entire summer. （读后续写·偶遇改变）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:in some way 更中性、更书面，纯指'方式不明'；somehow 除'方式不明'外还常带'费尽周折'或'莫名其妙'的情感色彩。

synonyms.example: For some reason, the melody drifting from the open window brought tears to my eyes. （读后续写·情感触动）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:for some reason 强调'原因不明'；somehow 可指'方式不明'也可指'原因不明'，语义更宽泛、更口语化。

synonyms.example: One way or another, we were determined to reach the summit before nightfall. （读后续写·登顶决心）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:one way or another 强调'不管用什么方法都要做成'的决心，语气更坚定；somehow 表决心时语气略弱、更随意。

advancedExpressions.expression: against all odds, somehow ...
advancedExpressions.example: Against all odds, somehow we clawed our way back from three goals down and snatched victory in the final seconds. （against all odds 让步短语 + somehow 强调'不可思议地做到'，渲染逆转的震撼）

advancedExpressions.expression: and then somehow ..., as if ...
advancedExpressions.example: And then somehow the knot in my chest began to loosen, as if a window had quietly been opened onto a brighter, kinder world. （then somehow 引出转折 + as if虚拟比喻，把抽象释然具象为'开窗'）

advancedExpressions.expression: somehow, it is often ... that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Somehow, it is often in our darkest, most desperate hours that we discover reserves of courage we never knew we possessed. （somehow软化断言 + it is...that强调句锁定核心，将现象升华为哲理）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Then somehow I began to feel free.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Then somehow, with the phone tucked away and my eyes lifted to the open sky for the first time in months, a quiet sense of freedom began to seep into my chest. （读后续写·心境释放）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: somehow 保留原句韵味 + with独立结构补背景(phone tucked away) + 通感动词 seep into 把抽象'自由'具象化 + 时间对比 for the first time in months

sentenceUpgrade.original: We finished the project on time.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Despite the crashed computers and the sleepless nights, we somehow pulled the project together right on the deadline, proof that determination can bend even the most stubborn circumstances. （议论文/记叙·坚韧主题）

original_sentence: I finally picked up the classic novel I had always wanted to read and was soon lost in the beautiful language.
readingExamples: I finally picked up the classic novel I had always wanted to read and was soon lost in the beautiful language.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. to be so absorbed in an activity or state that you are unaware of your surroundings
(2) phr. to be completely occupied by thought, emotion, or imagination
(3) phr. to be unable to find your way in (a place); to be surrounded and bewildered by something

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （信息、意义等）在……中丢失、被淹没
uncommonMeanings.example: So much of the poem's delicate beauty is lost in a hasty, word-for-word translation that misses the music between the lines. （议论文·翻译与文化，熟词僻义'被丢失/被淹没'）

posExamples.sentence: Curled up in the window seat with the rain drumming softly outside, I was soon lost in the beautiful language of the old novel, deaf to the world around me. （读后续写·沉浸阅读）
I would encourage every classmate to spend an hour each evening lost in a good book, for it is in those quiet pages that both knowledge and imagination flourish. （应用文·阅读倡议书）
Those who are perpetually lost in their smartphones risk missing the very richness of life — the laughter of friends, the beauty of a sunset, the small wonders that no screen can capture. （议论文·手机与生活）
For a long while she sat by the window, lost in thought, her fingers tracing the faded photograph as memories of that distant summer came flooding back. （读后续写·睹物思人）

idioms.example: So lost in thought was he that he did not hear the bell ring, nor notice the classroom slowly emptying around him. （读后续写·沉思出神，倒装强调）
As the music swelled, the dancers got lost in the moment, their movements flowing as naturally as a river. （读后续写·舞台沉醉）

collocations.example: She stood at the harbour, lost in thought, watching the ships melt into the grey horizon. （读后续写·怅然凝望）

collocations.phrase: be lost in a book / novel
collocations.translation: 沉浸于一本书 / 小说中
collocations.example: On rainy afternoons, nothing pleases me more than being lost in a good novel with a cup of steaming tea. （应用文·爱好介绍）

collocations.phrase: be lost in the beautiful language
collocations.example: I was so lost in the beautiful language of the poem that I read it aloud again and again, savouring every syllable. （读后续写·品味文字）
Eyes closed and swaying gently, the old pianist was utterly lost in the music, as though the concert hall had vanished around him. （读后续写·音乐沉醉）

collocations.phrase: be lost in memories / the past
collocations.translation: 沉浸在回忆 / 往事中
collocations.example: Turning the yellowed pages of the album, Grandma was lost in memories of a village that no longer existed. （读后续写·追忆往昔）

collocations.translation: 惊叹不已 / 满心钦佩
collocations.example: Standing beneath the towering waterfall, the travellers were lost in wonder, their earlier weariness completely forgotten. （读后续写·壮景震撼）

collocations.translation: 消失在人群中；淹没于人海
collocations.example: Before I could call out his name, he had already been lost in the crowd, swallowed by the surging tide of commuters. （读后续写·人海走失）

collocations.phrase: be lost in one's own world
collocations.example: The little boy, lost in his own world of dinosaurs and dragons, did not even glance up when his mother called him for dinner. （读后续写·童真专注）

synonyms.example: So absorbed in her painting was she that the paint dried on the brush before she noticed. （读后续写·专注创作）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:be absorbed in 强调'注意力被完全吸引、投入'，偏理性专注；be lost in 更带'忘我、沉醉'的情感色彩，常用于阅读、回忆、音乐等审美体验。

synonyms.example: Fully immersed in the local culture, the exchange student soon spoke the dialect like a native. （应用文/记叙·文化浸润）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:be immersed in 强调'长时间深度投入、浸泡'，常用于学习、文化、工作；be lost in 更瞬时、更感性，强调'一时忘我'。

synonyms.example: The whole class sat engrossed in the experiment, scarcely daring to breathe as the liquid changed colour. （读后续写·课堂专注）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:be engrossed in 语气最正式、书面，强调'高度专注到旁若无人'；be lost in 更口语、更富诗意，尤宜续写抒情场景。

advancedExpressions.expression: so lost in ... was sb. that ...
advancedExpressions.example: So lost in the melody was she that she failed to notice the hall had fallen silent and every eye had turned towards her. （so...that倒装到句首 + failed to notice强化忘我，把'沉浸'写到极致）

advancedExpressions.expression: there is nothing quite like being lost in ...
advancedExpressions.example: There is nothing quite like being lost in a well-loved book on a quiet afternoon; I sincerely urge every classmate to rediscover this simple joy. （there is nothing quite like...最高级式推荐 + 倡议句式，凸显阅读之美）

advancedExpressions.expression: to be lost in ... is not to lose oneself, but to find ...

sentenceUpgrade.original: I read the novel and forgot about time.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: I finally picked up the classic novel I had always longed to read, and within minutes I was lost in its beautiful language, utterly deaf to the ticking clock and the fading afternoon light. （读后续写·沉浸阅读）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 定语从句(I had always longed to read)补渴望 + be lost in核心短语 + utterly deaf to夸张写忘我 + 环境细节(ticking clock, fading light)烘托时间流逝

sentenceUpgrade.original: Reading is a good habit that benefits us.

sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my firm belief that...观点框架 + few...so...as比较结构强调 + where定语从句 + 三名词并列(knowledge, imagination, joy)收束升华

original_sentence: I kept a journal of my feelings, thoughts and daily activities to see how much progress I was making.
readingExamples: I kept a journal of my feelings, thoughts and daily activities to see how much progress I was making.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a written record in which you regularly note down your experiences, thoughts, and feelings; a diary
(2) n. a serious magazine or newspaper, especially one that deals with a specialist or academic subject
(3) n. a daily record of business transactions or official proceedings

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （学术）期刊，杂志（高考常考，区别于日记义）
uncommonMeanings.example: Her groundbreaking research was finally published in a leading scientific journal, earning her the recognition she had long deserved. （议论文/记叙·学术成就，熟词僻义'期刊'）

posExamples.sentence: Every night before bed, I opened my worn leather journal and poured out the day's small joys and worries, watching my scattered thoughts settle into calm, orderly lines. （读后续写·写日记的习惯）
I would strongly recommend that every student keep a journal, for the simple act of writing down our feelings each day helps us understand ourselves and track our growth. （应用文·学习方法建议信）
According to a recent article in a respected medical journal, keeping a daily journal can significantly reduce stress and sharpen one's memory. （议论文·健康与习惯，兼含'期刊'与'日记'双义）
Years later, flipping through her childhood journal, she laughed and wept at the earnest, misspelled hopes of the girl she used to be. （读后续写·重读旧日记）

collocations.example: My English teacher urged us to keep a journal in English, promising that a few honest sentences a day would transform our writing. （应用文·学习建议）
During the expedition, the young naturalist kept a detailed journal of every bird, plant and change in the weather. （读后续写·探险记录）
Unable to sleep, she wrote in her journal until dawn, letting the ink carry away the weight pressing on her heart. （读后续写·夜不能寐）
He guarded his private journal fiercely, for its pages held confessions he could share with no one else. （读后续写·内心秘密）

collocations.translation: 科学 / 学术 / 医学期刊
collocations.example: The findings were peer-reviewed and published in a prestigious academic journal, lending the theory long-awaited credibility. （议论文·学术论证）

collocations.phrase: an entry in a journal / a journal entry
collocations.example: The final journal entry, dated the day before the storm, ended abruptly in mid-sentence, leaving the rescuers chilled. （读后续写·悬念结尾）
Her travel journal, crammed with ticket stubs and hurried sketches, was a treasure map of unforgettable summers. （读后续写·旅行回忆）
Having his first paper published in a national journal, the shy graduate student could scarcely believe his own name in print. （记叙·学术里程碑）

synonyms.example: She confided every secret to her diary, its little brass lock the only guardian of her hopes and fears. （读后续写·少女心事）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:diary 更强调'按日期逐日记录个人生活'，偏私密；journal 涵盖更广，可指日记，也可指有主题的札记、观察记录，甚至学术期刊。

synonyms.example: The captain dutifully updated the ship's log, noting the coordinates, the weather and the dwindling supplies. （读后续写/记叙·航海记录）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:log 强调'系统、客观地记录数据、事件'，多用于航海、飞行、工作；journal 更侧重个人感受与思考的抒发。

synonyms.example: She flicked through a glossy fashion magazine while waiting for her turn at the salon. （应用文/记叙·日常场景）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:magazine 指面向大众的普通杂志（时尚、娱乐等）；journal 作'期刊'义时多指严肃、专业或学术性刊物。

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. poured ... into one's journal
advancedExpressions.example: That night she poured every unspoken fear into her journal, and as the words filled the page, the tightness in her chest gradually eased. （pour...into比喻情感宣泄 + and引出情绪释放的因果，写以笔疗心）

advancedExpressions.expression: keeping a journal is a habit worth cultivating, for ...
advancedExpressions.example: Keeping a journal is a habit well worth cultivating, for it not only preserves fleeting memories but also nurtures the ability to reflect. （动名词主语 + worth cultivating推荐 + not only...but also递进论证，倡议信实用句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: as research published in journals suggests, ...
advancedExpressions.example: As research published in leading psychology journals suggests, the habit of journaling can measurably lower anxiety and enhance emotional resilience. （as引导非限定 + published in journals借权威增强说服力，议论文引证句式）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I kept a journal to record my progress.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: I kept a journal of my feelings, thoughts and daily struggles, and turning back through its pages weeks later, I was astonished to see just how far, quietly and steadily, I had come. （读后续写·成长回顾）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: journal of三名词并列(feelings, thoughts, struggles) + 分词状语(turning back through...) + astonished情绪反应 + how far...I had come成长收束

sentenceUpgrade.original: Writing a journal every day is helpful for students.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my sincere conviction that the humble daily journal is one of the most powerful tools a student can wield, for through its honest pages we learn to observe, to reflect and, ultimately, to know ourselves. （应用文·建议信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my sincere conviction that...正式框架 + one of the most...最高级 + for引原因 + 三不定式递进(observe, reflect, know ourselves)升华

original_sentence: The details of the scene were revealed in front of me: the soft sunlight, a bird singing from a high tree branch, the rich and earthy smell of the soil after the rain.

definitionEn:
(1) vt. to make known something that was previously secret or unknown
(2) vt. to allow something to be seen that was previously hidden or covered
(3) vt. (of a fact or situation) to show or demonstrate something clearly

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （尤指电视节目、活动中的）揭晓，亮相时刻
uncommonMeanings.example: The whole family gathered around the screen for the big reveal, and when the curtains finally dropped, a collective gasp filled the room. （读后续写·揭晓时刻，熟词僻义作名词'揭晓'）

posExamples.sentence: As the morning mist slowly lifted, the valley revealed itself in breathtaking splendour: golden terraces, a silver ribbon of river, and a lone farmhouse crowned with drifting smoke. （读后续写·晨雾散尽·壮景展现）
I am writing to reveal a hidden gem in our community — a small volunteer library that, though little known, has quietly transformed the lives of dozens of children. （应用文·推荐信）
A closer examination of history reveals that every great advance in civilisation was born not of comfort, but of hardship and relentless effort. （议论文·历史与奋斗）

collocations.example: He hesitated, then, lowering his voice, revealed the secret he had carried alone for twenty long years. （读后续写·吐露心声）

As the fog thinned, the ancient castle revealed itself atop the cliff, majestic and half-swallowed by ivy. （读后续写·景物显现）
The survey revealed that a surprising number of students sacrifice sleep for their smartphones every night. （议论文/调查报告·数据揭示）
Recent studies reveal that even brief moments of gratitude can markedly improve our overall sense of well-being. （议论文·科学论证）

collocations.translation: 流露真情 / 显露真我
collocations.example: Only in that unguarded moment did his stern face soften, revealing the tender feelings he had always hidden. （读后续写·情感流露，倒装）

collocations.translation: 在……面前显现 / 向某人揭示
collocations.example: The full beauty of the scene was revealed to me only when I stopped rushing and truly looked. （读后续写·顿悟自然之美）
The talent show revealed a hidden gift for singing that even her closest friends had never suspected. （读后续写·才艺初现）

synonyms.example: The company finally disclosed the figures, and the board fell into a stunned, uneasy silence. （应用文/记叙·正式披露）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:disclose 更正式、更书面，多用于官方公开信息、数据、财务等；reveal 用法更广，可指抽象揭示，也可指景物、情感的显露。

synonyms.example: The brave journalist exposed the scandal, refusing to be silenced by threats or bribes. （议论文/记叙·揭露黑幕）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:expose 常含'揭露丑闻、罪行、真相中不光彩的一面'的负面色彩；reveal 中性，可褒可贬，情感范围更广。

synonyms.example: At the ceremony, the mayor unveiled the statue to a burst of applause and fluttering cameras. （应用文/记叙·揭幕仪式）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:unveil 字面'揭去面纱'，多用于正式场合首次公开雕像、产品、计划等；reveal 更日常、更通用，不限于'首次'。

synonyms.example: While clearing the attic, they uncovered a trunk of wartime letters that rewrote the family's history. （读后续写·意外发现）

advancedExpressions.expression: as ..., ... revealed itself in ...

sentenceUpgrade.original: Hard work is the reason for success.

original_sentence: Best of all, I began to appreciate the beauty in life with my own eyes, instead of through my smartphone camera.

definitionEn:

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 增值，升值（金融/财产）
uncommonMeanings.example: Grandfather always said the little cottage by the sea would appreciate in value, and years later, when the coast became a tourist hotspot, his quiet foresight left the whole family speechless. （读后续写·家族传承·远见）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 充分意识到，深刻理解（形势的严重性）
uncommonMeanings.example: Only after the storm swept away half the harvest did the villagers truly appreciate how fragile their comfortable lives had always been. （读后续写·灾难·顿悟）

posExamples.sentence: Standing at the mountaintop as dawn spilled gold across the valley, I finally learned to appreciate the beauty that had surrounded me all along, unnoticed behind the glow of my phone screen. （读后续写·自然顿悟）
I am writing to express how deeply I appreciate the tireless guidance you offered throughout the debate season, without which our team could never have reached the national final. （应用文·感谢信）
Students who take a gap year often come back with a heightened ability to appreciate the value of formal education, precisely because they have experienced life beyond the classroom. （议论文·教育话题）
We would greatly appreciate it if all residents could sort their household waste before the collection truck arrives each morning. （应用文·通知）

collocations.example: It was only when she slowed her pace that she began to appreciate the beauty of the ordinary — dew on a spider's web, sunlight through leaves. （读后续写·慢生活）

collocations.translation: 如果……将不胜感激（客套请求）
collocations.example: I would sincerely appreciate it if you could send me the detailed schedule of the summer volunteer programme at your earliest convenience. （应用文·询问信）
Having lived far from home for a year, I now truly appreciate the warmth of a family dinner in a way I never did before. （读后续写·思乡）

collocations.phrase: appreciate the value / importance of sth
collocations.example: Through this project, participants gradually came to appreciate the importance of teamwork over individual brilliance. （应用文·活动感悟）
On behalf of the whole class, I deeply appreciate the effort our teachers put into making the graduation ceremony unforgettable. （应用文·致辞）

collocations.translation: 感激某人的努力／善意／支持
collocations.example: She appreciated his quiet support far more than any loud words of encouragement could have expressed. （读后续写·情感）
Only by stepping out of our comfort zone can we learn to appreciate perspectives that differ radically from our own. （议论文·多元视角）
Fine art, unlike most possessions, tends to appreciate in value the longer it is held. （议论文·经济话题）

synonyms.example: He valued the old watch not for its price but for the memories it carried of his late father. （读后续写·遗物）
synonyms.usage: 侧重主观上认为某物重要而珍惜；appreciate 更强调因看到其优点而欣赏、感激

synonyms.example: She cherished every letter he wrote, tying them with a faded ribbon and reading them on lonely nights. （读后续写·思念）
synonyms.usage: 情感色彩最浓，多用于珍爱人或有情感意义之物；appreciate 更中性，可用于抽象价值与感激

synonyms.example: I shall always treasure the friendships forged during those unforgettable exchange days abroad. （应用文·告别信）
synonyms.usage: 语气强烈，强调把某物当作宝贝般珍藏；appreciate 侧重欣赏与感激，程度较轻

synonyms.example: The judges acknowledged the young inventor's ingenuity even though his device failed on stage. （议论文·创新）
synonyms.usage: 侧重公开承认某人的贡献或事实；appreciate 含有内心欣赏与感激之意

advancedExpressions.expression: it was not until ... that sb. came to appreciate ...
advancedExpressions.example: It was not until the noise of the city fell silent behind her that she came to appreciate just how much she had taken the quiet of home for granted. （not until 强调句 + 心理转折，续写升华段）

advancedExpressions.expression: words can hardly express how much I appreciate ...
advancedExpressions.example: Words can hardly express how much I appreciate the countless hours you devoted to guiding a clumsy beginner like me. （夸张修辞开头，感谢信情感铺垫）

advancedExpressions.expression: to truly appreciate ..., one must first ...
advancedExpressions.example: To truly appreciate the freedom we enjoy today, one must first understand the sacrifices made by those who came before us. （条件递进句式，引出论证前提）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I began to appreciate the beauty of life.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Slowly, as the frantic buzzing of notifications faded from my mind, I began to appreciate the quiet beauty of life unfolding right before my eyes — the crimson dusk, the laughter of strangers, the ordinary miracles I had scrolled past for years. （读后续写·顿悟+排比）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 副词开头控制节奏(Slowly) + as 时间状语从句 + 破折号引出排比意象(dusk, laughter, miracles) + 对比(scrolled past)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Thank you for helping me.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: I would like to take this opportunity to express my heartfelt appreciation for the selfless help you extended to me during my most difficult days. （应用文·感谢信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: take this opportunity to 正式套语 + heartfelt appreciation 名词化升级 + selfless help 形容词修饰 + during 时间状语点明背景

translation: 覆盖面广的，内容广泛的
original_sentence: Our wide-ranging conversation went so much deeper than brief texts ever could.
readingExamples: Our wide-ranging conversation went so much deeper than brief texts ever could.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. including or dealing with a great variety of different subjects, activities, or areas
(2) adj. covering or affecting a large area or a great extent
(3) adj. (of effects, consequences, powers) far-reaching and extensive in scope

posExamples.sentence: As the fire crackled between us that night, our wide-ranging conversation drifted from childhood dreams to distant galaxies, and I realized we had talked until the stars began to fade. （读后续写·深夜长谈）
Our club offers a wide-ranging programme of activities, from calligraphy and debate to astronomy and volunteering, so that every new member can find a passion of their own. （应用文·招新启事）
The wide-ranging benefits of reading — sharpened thinking, broadened horizons, and deepened empathy — make it far more than a mere pastime. （议论文·阅读价值）
The new policy is expected to have wide-ranging consequences for how students balance study and rest in the coming years. （议论文·政策影响）

collocations.example: Over dinner we fell into a wide-ranging discussion that leapt effortlessly from ancient poetry to modern physics. （读后续写·思想碰撞）
Climate change is already producing wide-ranging effects, from vanishing glaciers to unpredictable harvests. （议论文·环境）
A wide-ranging survey of our school revealed that most students crave more hands-on learning. （应用文·调查报告）
A boy of wide-ranging interests, he could discuss football and philosophy with equal enthusiasm. （读后续写·人物刻画）
Her wide-ranging experience abroad gave her a rare sensitivity to cultural differences. （应用文·推荐信）
The charity concert won wide-ranging support across the whole community. （应用文·活动报道）
The government announced wide-ranging measures to reduce students' academic burden. （议论文·教育政策）

synonyms.example: His extensive reading over the years lent his essays an unusual depth and range. （议论文·积累）
synonyms.usage: 侧重数量大、范围宽，常修饰研究、损害、知识；wide-ranging 更强调涵盖话题／领域的多样性

synonyms.example: One small act of kindness can have far-reaching effects on a stranger's entire day. （读后续写·善意）
synonyms.usage: 侧重影响、后果延伸得又广又深；wide-ranging 侧重内容或范围的广博

synonyms.example: The teacher handed out a comprehensive guide covering every stage of the writing process. （应用文·指南）
synonyms.usage: 强调面面俱到、无遗漏；wide-ranging 侧重跨越多个不同领域，不必然要求完整

synonyms.example: The festival celebrated the diverse traditions that make our community so vibrant. （应用文·文化活动）
synonyms.usage: 强调种类繁多且彼此不同；wide-ranging 更侧重覆盖的广度而非差异性本身

advancedExpressions.expression: our wide-ranging talk drifted from ... to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Our wide-ranging talk drifted from forgotten summers to unspoken fears, until the boundaries between two strangers quietly dissolved. （drift from...to... 意象流动 + 情感递进，续写长谈场景）

advancedExpressions.expression: with its wide-ranging ..., sth. offers something for everyone
advancedExpressions.example: With its wide-ranging selection of courses, our summer camp offers something for every curious mind. （介词短语前置 + 广度卖点，招募推介）

advancedExpressions.expression: the wide-ranging benefits of ... extend far beyond ...
advancedExpressions.example: The wide-ranging benefits of physical exercise extend far beyond a healthy body, reaching into our mood, focus and resilience. （extend beyond 拓展论点，凸显广度）

sentenceUpgrade.original: We talked about many different things.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Our wide-ranging conversation wandered freely from the books that had shaped us to the fears we had never dared to voice, going so much deeper than any brief text ever could. （读后续写·长谈）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: wide-ranging 精准替换 many different + wander freely 拟人化动词 + from...to... 意象对照 + go deeper than 比较升华

sentenceUpgrade.original: The activity has many benefits.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The wide-ranging benefits of such an activity — from fostering teamwork to nurturing lifelong friendships — make it an experience no student should miss. （议论文/推介）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: wide-ranging 提升正式度 + 破折号插入具体举例(from...to...) + make it 结论句强调 + no student should 增强号召力

original_sentence: We went to the opera, played badminton, and visited museums.
readingExamples: We went to the opera, played badminton, and visited museums.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a dramatic musical work in which the words are sung to orchestral accompaniment
(2) n. operas considered as an art form or genre
(3) n. a building or company where operas are performed

posExamples.sentence: As the soprano's final note soared through the grand hall, Grandpa gripped my hand tightly, and I saw a tear glisten in the eye of a man who had never once shown weakness — the opera had reached a place words never could. （读后续写·祖孙情）
I am writing to warmly invite you to a Chinese opera evening our club will host next Friday, where students will perform classic scenes and share the rich history behind each melody. （应用文·邀请信）
Some dismiss opera as an outdated art form, yet its power to convey raw human emotion through music alone makes it as relevant today as it was centuries ago. （议论文·传统艺术）
We spent that unforgettable week together: we went to the opera, played badminton in the park, and lost ourselves for hours in the quiet halls of the city museum. （读后续写·相聚时光）

collocations.example: On her birthday he surprised her with tickets to the opera, a treat she had dreamed of since childhood. （读后续写·惊喜）
The exchange students were spellbound by the vivid masks and soaring voices of Peking opera. （应用文·文化交流）
The old opera house, its gilded ceiling still glowing, had witnessed a century of triumphs and heartbreaks. （读后续写·场景描写）
Her lifelong dream was to become an opera singer whose voice could move an entire hall to tears. （读后续写·梦想）
The students staged a shortened opera to introduce classmates to this demanding art form. （应用文·活动）
Her afternoons were filled with a soap opera whose endless twists she could recount in astonishing detail. （读后续写·日常）

advancedExpressions.type: 读后续写·环境/情感烘托
advancedExpressions.expression: as the music of the opera swelled, ...
advancedExpressions.example: As the music of the opera swelled to its climax, the whole audience seemed to hold its breath as one. （as 从句 + swell 动态动词 + 群体反应烘托，续写高潮场景）

advancedExpressions.expression: an evening of opera that celebrates ...
advancedExpressions.example: Join us for an evening of opera that celebrates the timeless beauty of our cultural heritage. （祈使句号召 + that 定语从句点明意义，邀请/海报）

advancedExpressions.expression: far from being outdated, opera remains ...
advancedExpressions.example: Far from being outdated, opera remains a living bridge between the emotions of the past and the audiences of today. （Far from 让步开头 + bridge 隐喻，传统艺术论证）

sentenceUpgrade.original: We went to the opera and enjoyed it.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: That evening we went to the opera, and as the final aria faded into a hush, we sat motionless in the dark, unwilling to break the spell the music had woven around us. （读后续写·沉浸）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: as 时间从句叠加 + fade into a hush 通感 + sit motionless 动作静默 + weave a spell 隐喻收束

sentenceUpgrade.original: Opera is an old art but still good.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Though opera is often labelled an art of the past, it endures precisely because it speaks to emotions that no era can outgrow. （议论文·传统艺术）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Though 让步状语从句 + be labelled 被动委婉 + precisely because 因果强调 + no era can outgrow 抽象升华

original_sentence: We went to the opera, played badminton, and visited museums.
readingExamples: We went to the opera, played badminton, and visited museums.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a game played by two or four people who use light rackets to hit a shuttlecock over a net
(2) n. the sport of badminton as a recreational or competitive activity

posExamples.sentence: In the golden light of the late afternoon, we played badminton until the shuttlecock became a mere shadow against the darkening sky, our laughter echoing across the empty court. （读后续写·青春时光）
To promote a healthier campus, our sports club warmly invites all students to join the friendly badminton tournament to be held this Saturday afternoon in the school gym. （应用文·活动通知）
Team sports such as badminton teach young people far more than physical fitness; they cultivate cooperation, resilience and the grace to accept defeat. （议论文·体育教育）

collocations.example: Every weekend the two friends would play badminton in the park, rain or shine. （读后续写·友情日常）
The newly built badminton court quickly became the liveliest corner of our campus. （应用文·校园报道）
He gripped the badminton racket tightly, determined not to lose the final point. （读后续写·比赛）
The inter-class badminton tournament drew an enthusiastic crowd of cheering classmates. （应用文·活动）
A quick game of badminton after class was all it took to melt away the day's stress. （读后续写·放松）

advancedExpressions.expression: the shuttlecock arced back and forth as ...
advancedExpressions.example: The shuttlecock arced back and forth against the sunset sky, and for a while the whole world shrank to that small white blur and the sound of our laughter. （arc 动态动词 + 世界缩小到细节，续写沉浸画面）

advancedExpressions.expression: we cordially invite you to take part in a badminton ...
advancedExpressions.example: We cordially invite you to take part in a badminton tournament designed to bring more energy and friendship to campus life. （cordially invite 正式套语 + designed to 目的状语，通知/邀请）

advancedExpressions.expression: a sport like badminton does more than ...; it ...
advancedExpressions.example: A sport like badminton does more than strengthen the body; it teaches us to stay composed when the score is against us. （does more than 递进否定 + 分号并列，凸显体育的教育意义）

sentenceUpgrade.original: We played badminton in the afternoon.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: All afternoon we chased the shuttlecock across the court, our shirts damp with sweat and our faces bright with a joy that no screen had ever given us. （读后续写·青春）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: chase the shuttlecock 具象动作 + across the court 空间感 + 独立主格(shirts damp, faces bright) + no screen had given 对比主题

sentenceUpgrade.original: Playing badminton is good for students.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Regularly playing badminton offers students not only a fitter body but also a sharper mind and a stronger sense of teamwork. （议论文·体育价值）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Regularly 副词强调习惯 + not only...but also 递进结构 + 三重益处并列(body, mind, teamwork)

original_sentence: I cannot escape from the modern world, but I can cut back on the amount of time I spend on my smartphone every day, and I do.
readingExamples: I cannot escape from the modern world, but I can cut back on the amount of time I spend on my smartphone every day, and I do.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. v. to reduce the amount, size, or extent of something, especially spending, consumption, or an activity
(2) phr. v. to do less of something or use less of something in order to save resources or improve one's situation

posExamples.sentence: After that quiet evening by the lake, I resolved to cut back on the hours I lost to my phone, and slowly the world around me — birdsong, sunlight, the faces of friends — came sharply back into focus. （读后续写·自我改变）
To protect our environment, I sincerely urge every classmate to cut back on the use of disposable plastics and carry a reusable bottle instead. （应用文·倡议书）
If teenagers were encouraged to cut back on screen time, they would likely discover more meaningful ways to spend the precious hours of their youth. （议论文·青少年与科技）
The company decided to cut back on unnecessary expenses in order to survive the difficult year ahead. （应用文·报告）

collocations.example: The family had to cut back on spending after the sudden loss of the father's job. （读后续写·困境）
Doctors increasingly advise young people to cut back on screen time before bed for the sake of better sleep. （议论文·健康）

collocations.phrase: cut back on sugar / salt / meat
collocations.example: Determined to grow healthier, she began to cut back on sugar and fill her plate with fresh vegetables instead. （读后续写·健康转变）

collocations.phrase: cut back on the use of sth
collocations.example: Our school launched a campaign urging everyone to cut back on the use of paper. （应用文·环保活动）
Small daily choices, such as cutting back on plastic bags, add up to a real difference for the planet. （议论文·环保）
The doctor advised him to cut back on his working hours before his health broke down completely. （读后续写·警醒）
By walking to school instead of driving, our community significantly cut back on carbon emissions within a single year. （应用文·环保成果）

synonyms.example: He tried to cut down on late-night snacks to keep himself in shape for the season. （读后续写·自律）
synonyms.usage: 与 cut back on 几乎同义、可互换，都指减少某习惯／消费；cut back on 略偏正式，常用于开支、资源、时间

synonyms.example: Planting more trees along the roads can noticeably reduce air pollution in the city. （议论文·环境）
synonyms.usage: 最正式、最通用的单个动词，直接跟宾语(reduce sth)；cut back on 更口语化，强调从原有水平上削减

synonyms.example: The new rules aim to curb the excessive use of smartphones among primary school pupils. （议论文·管控）
synonyms.usage: 侧重控制、遏制某种增长或不良趋势，语气较强、较正式；cut back on 侧重自身主动减少

synonyms.example: In hard times the family learned to economize on every drop of water and every grain of rice. （读后续写·节俭）
synonyms.usage: 专指为省钱／省资源而节约，用法较书面；cut back on 适用范围更广，不限于节省资源

advancedExpressions.expression: from that day on, I resolved to cut back on ...
advancedExpressions.example: From that day on, I resolved to cut back on the endless scrolling that had quietly stolen my evenings, and to give that time back to the people I loved. （from that day on 时间标志 + resolved to 决心 + give back to 情感落点，续写转变段）

advancedExpressions.expression: let us start by cutting back on ...
advancedExpressions.example: Let us start by cutting back on the plastic we use each day, for every small step brings us closer to a greener campus. （Let us 号召句 + for 引出理由，倡议书行动呼吁）

advancedExpressions.expression: one effective solution is to cut back on ...
advancedExpressions.example: One effective solution to this growing problem is to cut back on our reliance on digital devices and rediscover the value of face-to-face connection. （one solution is to 提出对策 + rediscover 正向替代，议论文对策段）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I decided to use my phone less.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: That night, staring at the hours the screen had swallowed, I made a quiet vow to cut back on my phone use and reclaim the fragments of life I had let slip away unnoticed. （读后续写·决心）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 分词状语(staring at...) + swallow 拟物化 + make a vow 正式化 + reclaim / slip away 对比动词升华主题

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should use less plastic to protect nature.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: If each of us is willing to cut back on plastic, however slightly, our combined efforts will grow into a powerful force for protecting the fragile world we share. （应用文·倡议）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: If 条件句号召 + however slightly 让步插入 + combined efforts 集体力量 + grow into 隐喻 + fragile world 情感修饰
